🧘 Forward Fold — 6-Week Progression (reference)›
Overview: 10 minutes • Daily • 5 Steps. Patience • Consistency • Control • Progress
Progress milestones: 1 Hands to knees → 2 Mid-shin → 3 Ankles → 4 Fingertips floor → 5 Palms flat → 6 Chest to thighs
Hamstrings worked: Biceps femoris, Semitendinosus, Semimembranosus
Mantra: "Every rep • Every second • Every day = Progress." Stay consistent: 10 min/day, 6 days/week, track progress, trust the process
About this program: 6 weeks of daily practice to unlock hamstrings and achieve a full forward fold
Consistency is everything — 15 min daily beats 2 hours once a week
Never bounce or force a stretch — pain means stop immediately
Morning is great for activation — evening is better for stretching
Tight hip flexors will fight you — add 60s kneeling lunge stretch daily
Film yourself monthly to see progress
Week 1 — Activate & Awaken (15 min daily). Goal: learn posterior pelvic tilt, wake up glutes and abs
Supine posterior pelvic tilt — 3x10x5s holds. Flatten lower back into floor, breathe normally
Dead bug (bent knee) — 2x8/side. Press lower back flat before lowering each leg, slow/controlled
Glute bridge — 3x10. Tuck tailbone at top, squeeze glutes fully
Seated forward fold (passive) — 3x30s hold. Legs straight, reach forward without straining, breathe
Week 2 — Lengthen the Back Chain (20 min daily). Goal: actively stretch hamstrings with pelvic control
Standing posterior pelvic tilt — 3x10x5s holds. Tuck tailbone under while standing, abs gently engaged
Supine hamstring stretch (strap/towel) — 3x45s/leg. Keep lower back flat, pull gently, no bouncing
Glute bridge with tilt — 3x12. Posterior tilt at top of every rep
Standing forward fold (soft knees) — 3x45s. Bend knees slightly, hinge from hips, head hangs heavy
Week 3 — Hip Hinge Mastery (20 min daily). Goal: learn to fold from hips, not lower back
Wall hip hinge drill — 3x10. Stand 6in from wall, push hips back to touch it, keep back flat
Cat-cow with pelvic focus — 2x10 slow reps. Exaggerate posterior tilt on cat phase
Single-leg hamstring stretch — 3x45s each. One leg extended, other bent, hinge forward with flat back
Standing forward fold (straighter legs) — 3x60s. Gradually straighten legs week by week, never force
Week 4 — Depth & Control (25 min daily). Goal: increase fold depth while maintaining pelvic position
Active hamstring flexion (lying) — 3x12/side. Lift straight leg, hold 2s at top, pelvis neutral throughout
Pyramid pose hold — 3x60s/side. Front leg straight, hinge chest toward shin, breathe into tightness
Seated straddle fold — 3x60s. Legs wide, walk hands forward from hips, keep spine long
Standing forward fold — 3x60–90s. Feet hip-width, grab elbows, sway gently, surrender into stretch
Week 5 — Progressive Loading (25 min daily). Goal: add gentle load and longer holds to deepen flexibility
Weighted forward fold (light) — 3x60s. Hold 2–5lb weight or book, let gravity assist fold
Posterior tilt + march (standing) — 3x10/leg. Maintain pelvic tilt while slowly lifting knees alternately
Down dog to forward fold flow — 3x5 slow reps. Walk feet to hands, hold fold 10s, walk back to down dog
Rag doll pose — 3x90s. Feet hip-width, deep bend, grab elbows overhead, full surrender
Week 6 — The Full Fold (25 min daily). Goal: integrate everything, reach the floor
Full warm-up flow — 1 round, 5 min. Cat-cow, glute bridges, hip hinges — get body ready to move
Active standing forward fold — 3x5 pulses + 30s hold. Pulse gently to edge of stretch, then relax/breathe
Toe touch progression — 5x10s each. Each attempt, breathe out and try to go slightly deeper
Full forward fold hold — 3x2 min. Flat feet, straight legs or close, fingertips/palms to floor
Coach's notes: never bounce or force a stretch — pain means stop. Morning for activation, evening for stretching. Tight hip flexors will fight you — add 60s kneeling lunge stretch daily. Film yourself monthly to see progress
